title: Elmerpolitian's Food
description: Have you ever wanted to have a variety of food without needing to install multiple mods at the same time for different food items? Well this mod bring an insane amount of food without needing dependencies!
body:
## Is it possible to have A LOT of food items in MINECRAFT?

-Elmerpolitian's Food contains a lot of food items that'll continue to grow as development continues. I am developing new food items as we go along! You can suggest new food items by heading over to our sub-reddit page by [Clicking Here!](https://www.reddit.com/r/Elmerpolitian/) 

As of V.0.5.0 Alpha we have the following items:
- Tomato
- Cheese
- Orange
- Loaf of Bread
- Sliced Tomatoes
- Tomato Soup
- Cooked Egg
- Blender
- & Knife
  
![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e2cfc9b6d646ceb876161e14fe465f1d068a81c_0.webp)

This mod allows a cooking environment inside of minecraft without having to download individual mods.

We are currently adding more items as we go along and we will be updating this page as more items and more features are added to this Modrinth page.

"Do you want to check out our teasers and our progress page?" - We now have a discord forum that shows the progress of our work! Starting on June 8th of 2026, all progress from Elmerpolitian Entertainment, Elmerpolitian Video Entertainment, and Politian Audio will now go into the development tab in our official Discord Server! We will provide teasers for our upcoming work to hype our fan base with our new progress!

Check out our progress page on our Discord! - https://discord.com/channels/1176181323971444736/1513584933283692674

**WARNING: OUR MOD IS NOT IN FULL RELEASE! THIS MOD IS PROGRESSIVELY CHANGING AND MIGHT BE UNSTABLE IN SOME CASES. PLEASE, LET US KNOW IF YOU RUN INTO SOME ISSUES. Thank you!! - Elmerpolitian Video Entertainment CEO, Mango!
